in_sanskrit.name: Chahatika
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Desire, Passion
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Chahatika एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। A name derived from the Sanskrit word 'Chahati', meaning 'desire' or 'passion'. In Hindu mythology, Chahatika is believed to represent the fiery passion and intense emotions that drive individuals to pursue their goals and dreams. The name carries a powerful spiritual significance, symbolizing the inner fire that fuels one's journey through life.
